findings.title: P2: Distinguish the bridge receipt from the committed design result
findings.body: The registered runtime map labels Agent Bridge → Control as “fenced design result”. At the page’s pinned revision b2b85d4c8d3174aa41507cde77637227bb709e1e, AgentJobRunner.runOne sends a Worker attempt outcome to /jobs/:id/finish; finishAgentRun separately requires job.result to have already been committed. Designs are committed by the OpenClaw tool through /v1/agent/design-sets or /v1/agent/revisions, under lockAgentResult. This distinction matters when an execution receipt exists without a committed design. Correct the owning Mermaid definition and adjacent alternative in docs/site/understand/prism-runtime.md:49 to distinguish these handoffs, then refresh this registration.

findings.title: P2: Represent the ownership contract’s additional empty-state transitions
findings.body: The registered state diagram gives empty only an outgoing transition to disposed. Its pinned ownership-state.ts transition table also permits empty → empty, empty → unresolved and empty → abandoned. The self-transition is meaningful: ownership-store.ts permits installing previously absent finalObservation while already empty, including converted legacy records. Consequently the diagram and alternative do not fully answer the registered question about permitted progress and unresolved stops. Update the owning definition at docs/site/understand/worker-core.md:657 and its alternative with the applicable conditions, or explicitly distinguish a simplified supervisor path from the full store transition contract; then refresh this hash.
